changes: Distinct started/finished observer IDs for multiple automatic invocations.
Retain memory tied to a single admitted full-path build even when unknown test selections are also requested.
Do not use Bash quote semantics to classify cmd.exe commands; Windows keeps prior unknown metadata.
limitations: Windows fallback guard is tested with an explicit platform parameter; real Windows execution is not tested. These post-model changes have no model/cache/resource outcome measurement. Raw failing npm control now refuses completion despite a current build. F13/F14 frozen model snapshots and bindings remain unchanged.
